_doc: E-MT-01 adversarial mutation matrix (frozen 2026-07-10). Before E-MT-00 code is accepted, every failure_class must have >=1 seeded_defect that turns a clean MeasurementContract probe RED when the mutation is active and GREEN when clean. Historical F-xxx anchors are evidence of discovered failure modes — not economic closures.
coverage_rule: COMPLETE iff every failure_class has at least one seeded_defect with status PLANNED|IMPLEMENTED and detector_probe non-empty.

failure_classes.title: Detection stream counted as trade population
failure_classes.semantic_substitution: n_detections → n_trades; opportunity rows treated as executed trades

seeded_defects.mutation: Replace trade_decision population with opportunities.jsonl rows without execution filter; keep metric n_trades label
seeded_defects.inject: fixture: swap population loader to detection stream; leave contract.unit_of_analysis=trade_decision

failure_classes.title: Stream outcome/rr used as economic truth without re-derive
failure_classes.semantic_substitution: opportunities.outcome / rr_achieved → realized trade R

seeded_defects.mutation: Set y from stream outcome while contract.derivation_authority=forward_walk.intrabar_fixed; inject inconsistent SL_HIT on paths that never touch SL
seeded_defects.inject: fixture rows with outcome=SL_HIT and path min>stop; label builder trusts outcome field

failure_classes.title: Zone registry economic labels from contaminated stream
failure_classes.semantic_substitution: stored zone mean_RR/SL-hit → honest forward_walk labels

seeded_defects.mutation: Use zone_registry stored SL-hit ≈0.98 as y_win proxy instead of re-derived forward_walk
seeded_defects.inject: label path reads models/zone_registry.json meta labels

failure_classes.title: RR model training labels from contaminated stream
failure_classes.semantic_substitution: rr_dataset_builder y_win/y_rr from stream outcome → forward economic R

seeded_defects.mutation: Train/eval metric uses y_rr from stream while contract bans stream fields
seeded_defects.inject: fixture: y_rr copied from outcome without forward_walk

failure_classes.title: Degenerate dual labels (y_rr ≈ y_win)
failure_classes.semantic_substitution: two named targets that are algebraically almost identical presented as independent

seeded_defects.mutation: Define y_rr = 1.0 if win else -1.0 while reporting separate IC for y_rr and y_win
seeded_defects.inject: label builder forces y_rr∈{+1,-1} from y_win

failure_classes.title: Same feature name, different quantity (train/serve or pipeline/CRT)
failure_classes.semantic_substitution: pipeline retest_depth/disp_strength ↔ CRT displacement_retrace/displacement_atr_ratio under shared keys

seeded_defects.mutation: Emit FM-021 value under key expected to be FM-027 (or reverse)
seeded_defects.inject: feature map alias retest_depth → displacement_retrace without formula change

failure_classes.title: Divergent formula under shared semantic name
failure_classes.semantic_substitution: body_ratio = body/total_wick vs body/range

seeded_defects.mutation: Compute body_ratio as body/total_wick while contract binds FM-010 body/range
seeded_defects.inject: swap candle_math call to wick denominator path

failure_classes.title: Centered window / future bar leakage in feature builder
failure_classes.semantic_substitution: causal trailing feature → center=True swing using future bars

seeded_defects.mutation: Enable center=True (or equivalent) so feature at t uses t+k
seeded_defects.inject: builder flag center=True on swing/ATR window

failure_classes.title: Full-sample rank/percentile as if point-in-time
failure_classes.semantic_substitution: expanding/trailing rank → global rank over entire series

seeded_defects.mutation: volatility_regime = percentile rank over full sample instead of trailing window
seeded_defects.inject: rank(pct) without time-causal mask

failure_classes.title: Research path gate-OFF claimed as full fusion spine
failure_classes.semantic_substitution: CRT-only backtest entries → EngineRunner 4-engine fusion results

seeded_defects.mutation: Set engine_gate_mode=gate_on_fusion in contract while BACKTEST_ENGINE_GATE=0 / EngineRunner.run never called
seeded_defects.inject: env BACKTEST_ENGINE_GATE=0; contract claims fusion

failure_classes.title: RR fusion path doubles Gaussian under another name
failure_classes.semantic_substitution: base RREngine → rr_fusion gaussian bypass as 'rr' score

seeded_defects.mutation: Enable rr_fusion while contract.expected_engines lists base rr only; scores correlate ~1 with gaussian
seeded_defects.inject: rr_fusion.enabled=true with bypass-dominant confidence

failure_classes.title: Confidence gate mis-scaled for feature dimension (always bypass)
failure_classes.semantic_substitution: Mahalanobis confidence as calibrated P(in-dist) when floor is ~exp(-0.5*dof)

seeded_defects.mutation: Use legacy_scalar confidence_bypass_threshold that rejects 100% in-sample as if selective
seeded_defects.inject: threshold=0.3 with exp(-0.5*d_sq) on dof~27

failure_classes.title: Polarity score wired into true-RR threshold gate
failure_classes.semantic_substitution: RREngine polarity∈[0.5,1] → DecisionEngine rr_threshold (e.g. 1.5) as reward/risk

seeded_defects.mutation: Gate requires fusion.rr >= 1.5 while rr feature is polarity in [0,1]
seeded_defects.inject: decision gate threshold 1.5 on polarity field

failure_classes.title: Built-but-unwired module counted as measured path
failure_classes.semantic_substitution: sidecar/orphan component → live spine consumer

seeded_defects.mutation: List TradeNet/PortfolioAllocator/CognitiveBus in modules_in_path while call count=0 on research path
seeded_defects.inject: contract modules_in_path includes orphan; probe call graph shows 0

failure_classes.title: Feature flag off but experiment claims component active
failure_classes.semantic_substitution: use_bitnet:false path → BitNet-gated decisions

seeded_defects.mutation: feature_flags.use_bitnet=true in claims while config false / client not invoked
seeded_defects.inject: mismatch flag claim vs runtime

failure_classes.title: Active config version ≠ schema/code line under test
failure_classes.semantic_substitution: documented v4 behavior → v2 active file; missing sections use silent defaults

seeded_defects.mutation: contract.config_version_source claims keys absent from CRTConfig / ACTIVE_VERSION file
seeded_defects.inject: point to wrong production JSON or inject unknown override keys

failure_classes.title: Integrity check exists but does not gate the path
failure_classes.semantic_substitution: config_integrity report present → enforced preflight

seeded_defects.mutation: Skip integrity gate while evidence_artifacts claims integrity ran
seeded_defects.inject: stub report file without call-site invocation

failure_classes.title: Registry manifest active artifact ≠ runtime-loaded file
failure_classes.semantic_substitution: manifest active sha → config path sha

seeded_defects.mutation: Point zone_gate_registry active to different sha than engine_runner.zone_registry_path
seeded_defects.inject: manifest active:true on file A; runtime loads file B

failure_classes.title: L3 dataset integrity claimed but not called on research stream
failure_classes.semantic_substitution: inline L1/L2 only → full validate_dataset L3

seeded_defects.mutation: dataset_integrity_level=L1_L2_L3 while stream path never calls validate_dataset
seeded_defects.inject: research loader without L3; contract claims L3

failure_classes.title: Gross or wrong bps presented as net success
failure_classes.semantic_substitution: gross PnL / 0 bps → net with declared taker+slippage+funding

seeded_defects.mutation: success_gate computed on gross while contract.success_gate_uses=net; or zero costs despite components declared
seeded_defects.inject: cost function returns 0; metrics use gross for gate

failure_classes.title: Stream/proxy exit substituted for declared forward_walk exit
failure_classes.semantic_substitution: stream outcome path → intrabar_fixed SL/TP under contract params

seeded_defects.mutation: Take exit from stream outcome field while contract.exit_family=intrabar_fixed_sl_tp
seeded_defects.inject: bypass forward_walk; copy outcome

failure_classes.title: Overlapping labels / no embargo across train-test
failure_classes.semantic_substitution: random or chronological split without purge → purged+embargoed WF

seeded_defects.mutation: Allow label horizons to overlap train and test; embargo=0 while contract.purge requires purge
seeded_defects.inject: kfold without purge on multi-bar labels

failure_classes.title: Unknown categorical mapped to silent default class
failure_classes.semantic_substitution: unknown session → london index without error

seeded_defects.mutation: Map unknown session string to 0.0 (london) instead of fail/NaN per contract
seeded_defects.inject: session encoder default 0

failure_classes.title: Statistical significance reported as economic success
failure_classes.semantic_substitution: p<0.05 / AUC / IC → success_gate without net expectancy

seeded_defects.mutation: Mark SUPPORTED because permutation p<0.05 while net E<0 and success_gate requires net
seeded_defects.inject: verdict writer ignores economic_metrics

failure_classes.title: INSUFFICIENT power labeled HARMFUL / strong conclusion
failure_classes.semantic_substitution: n<min cells → REGIME_HARMFUL / HARMFUL

seeded_defects.mutation: Aggregate underpowered negative cells into HARMFUL
seeded_defects.inject: rollup without n guard

failure_classes.title: Config/metric metadata decorative — not consumed
failure_classes.semantic_substitution: knob present in config → knob affects measurement

seeded_defects.mutation: Vary declared behavioral knob with byte-identical ledger while claiming sensitivity
seeded_defects.inject: parameter sweep with no consumer

failure_classes.title: Overlapping or detection n used as independent decision n
failure_classes.semantic_substitution: overlapping label count / detections → independent trade decisions

seeded_defects.mutation: Report n=100 from overlapping 1-bar-shifted events while contract.overlap_policy=forbid_overlapping_labels
seeded_defects.inject: count rows not independent decisions

checks: unit_of_analysis consistent with row constructor
detection_vs_trade matches data source
population fingerprint excludes pure detections when unit=trade_decision
re-derive y via forward_walk under contract exits+costs
agreement >= min_agreement on critical fields
sign-flip rate and expectancy delta reported
derivation_authority != forbidden_stream_outcome for economic label_family
stream_fields_banned not present in y path
corr(|y_a|,|y_b|) or equality rate below degeneracy threshold if both claimed independent
each output key maps to declared fm_id/formula_ref
not_equal_to collisions fail if equal within tolerance
scalar registry formula matches builder output on golden candles
zero sensitivity to future-bar perturbation beyond t
no full-sample rank when trailing required
unknown categoricals raise or NA; never map to a valid class index
success metric uses net when success_gate_uses=net
declared cost components nonzero on fixture round-trip
exit path is contract.code_entrypoint
not_equal_to sources not used
no train/test label horizon overlap under purge rule
embargo bars empty of samples
economic success_gate not satisfiable by p-value/IC alone
info metrics cannot set SUPPORTED for economic experiments
n < n_declared_min → INSUFFICIENT not HARMFUL
declared knobs change ledger or are marked decorative
reported n equals independent unit count under overlap_policy
engine_gate_mode matches runtime
expected_engines actually constructed/called
no silent gaussian duplicate under rr name
confidence gate not 100% constant bypass on training distribution when claimed selective
score domain compatible with threshold domain
modules_in_path have call count >0 on fixture path
modules_explicitly_out_of_path have call count 0
feature_flags match loaded config and invocation
ACTIVE_VERSION resolves
required keys load without silent defaults for declared sections
integrity function invoked on path, not only report file present
manifest active sha == runtime loaded artifact sha
if level L1_L2_L3 then validate_dataset (or declared L3) called

coverage_summary.implementation_status: PLANNED_MATRIX_FROZEN — no E-MT-00 code until this matrix is referenced by tests
